impacts.description: Improved employability and career prospects of MSCA postdoctoral fellows within academia and beyond, through an increased set of research and transferable skills and competences.
Increased and broadened research and innovation impact through enhanced networking and communication capacities with scientific peers and the general public.
Stronger R&I capacity and output among participating organisations and better transfer of knowledge into research, teaching and education.
Increased global attractiveness, visibility and reputation of European participating research organisations.

Stimulated innovation and knowledge transfer and expanded career opportunities for researchers by promoting career moves between sectors and organisations through the non-academic placement incentive.
Spread of excellence and fostering of balanced brain circulation in widening countries through ERA Fellowships undertaken in a widening country.
